title: Steal the Design.md Files of Apple, Spotify, Ferrari, Tesla, and 2,000+ Top Brands for Your AI
description:
If you want better front end designs, don't start prompting from scratch.

You can use the design language of top brands like Tesla, Apple, Ferrari, and even Anthropic.

Directly inside your own designs.

Someone reverse engineered over 2,000 websites from the world's top brands.

They turned them into design files that your Claude Code can read and use directly.

Each file contains their entire visual system.

The exact colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts they use.

Plus clear rules on what to use and what to avoid.

So you just pick the one that fits your project.

You drop it into your coding agent.

It builds your entire UI in that exact style in minutes.

Think of it like handing your AI a style guide straight from a real design team, instead of guessing what looks good.

No more staring at a blank screen wondering where to even start.

You already know the exact brand aesthetic you're going for, now your AI does too.

Plus the whole library is completely free right now.

#designmd #claudecode #3dwebsite #websitedesigning #aicoding
